source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 1ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιοι Γερβάσιος και Λέων οι αυτάδελφοι»

attestations.note: One page holds the two of them and gives them two sentences: «Οι Άγιοι Γερβάσιος και Λέων μαρτύρησαν κατά τον 2ο αιώνα μ.Χ. Ο Άγιος Λέων ήταν Απόστολος των Βάσκων». The day's line calls them «οι αυτάδελφοι», own brothers. «Απόστολος των Βάσκων» is the page's title for him and is kept in the life; it is not taken as the rank apostle, which the corpus reserves for the seventy and the twelve. The corpus keeps a dozen other men of this name and none of them is on this day. No country, no judge, no manner of death, no relic, no distich and no hymn stand on this page.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding menologion day (30 September 2026).

death.note: saint.gr: «Οι Άγιοι Γερβάσιος και Λέων μαρτύρησαν κατά τον 2ο αιώνα μ.Χ.» — they were martyred in the second century after Christ. That is the only date the page gives, and it gives it for the pair.
